headline: Judicial Clerk Admits To Listing His Own Goldfish As 'Legal Consultant' On Supreme Court Conflict-Of-Interest Disclosure Forms
body:
Q: Mr. Chatterjee, why did you feel it was necessary to list 'Bubbles' as a Senior Legal Consultant on your formal disclosure documents?

A: It wasn't about professional standing, really. It was about availability. Most legal consultants are busy with billable hours, whereas Bubbles provides constant, silent, aqueous oversight during my case research. I felt his contribution to my stress levels was significant enough to warrant a formal declaration.

Q: The Ethics Committee has flagged this because the goldfish was simultaneously receiving a stipend from a firm involved in current litigation. Do you see the conflict?

A: People keep using the word 'conflict,' but I see it as 'aquatic impartiality.' Bubbles has never once uttered a biased opinion on constitutional matters, mostly because he lacks vocal cords and lungs. Can you truly say the same for your average law firm associate?

Q: Does the committee still plan to investigate the fish's bank account?

A: They’ve certainly tried, but the account is entirely offshore—or, more accurately, kept inside a decorative ceramic castle in his tank. Frankly, if the court continues this line of questioning, I intend to call Bubbles to testify, provided the courtroom has adequate plumbing.
caption: A judicial clerk has finally come clean about his most trusted advisor. Legal experts are baffled, but the goldfish remains unbothered. #JusticeSystem #LegalHumor #GoldfishCounsel (satire)
igHook: Would you trust a legal opinion from a pet that only eats twice a day?
